title: Injectivity of matching-code decoding
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, let $m$ be a natural number, and let $V$ be a list of elements of $\alpha$ of length $2m$ with no repetitions. Decode each perfect-matching code of size $m$ using $V$, and form the simple graph generated by the resulting list of pairs. The map sending a code to this graph is injective.
